audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart shows blanket 'Skill' for levels 1-6 while content layer and packet both give Ekko all five early rows.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and 48.81% WR support Ekko-favored early; content whys are grounded.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to Ekko with grounded whys.

audit.why: Spikes (Ekko 3-5 all-in, Chronobreak at 6, Ryze first-item waveclear, late out-scaling) match kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four flagged missing interactions: R untargetability dodging your commit, R heal needing anti-heal, W shield absorbing burst, and the Phase Dive auto-reset tell. Cooldowns field has no digit; packet flags zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Kit: Chronobreak 110s (untargetable + heals % of damage received), Parallel Convergence 22s (shield + stun), Phase Dive auto-reset.
audit.corrected: Folded into cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, enemyWin, and the itemization line.

edits.before: - Ekko Chronobreak: matchup-defining — Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Check it before every step-up. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Ekko Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1 — he goes untargetable, heals, and bursts back; hold final damage until after it. - W Rune Prison is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Parallel Convergence is 22s — his stun all-in runs on a long timer.

edits.before: Erases your kill and bursts back — track the hologram and save final damage for after it. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: The Phase Dive wind-up is your step-back cue — the reset auto teleports him in. Root the arrival, save damage for after R.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: A centered wave keeps his 325-range Phase Dive entry honest and lights the roams — Ekko kills off fog, not even lanes.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: His W-empowered autos shred low-health targets and one stun all-in deletes half bars — at half HP that greed is a death.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP feeds the same map plan. Nothing else is defensible on him.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots (Tear first back). RoA into Seraph's, then Rabadon's; Zhonya's vs dive. The mana items ARE the damage items — never skip the battery.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots (Tear first back). RoA into Seraph's, then Rabadon's; Zhonya's vs dive, Oblivion Orb vs the Chronobreak heal. The mana items ARE the damage items.

edits.before: Ekko wins by landing Chronobreak, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Ekko wins by stunning you in Parallel Convergence, bursting off Phase Dive, and erasing your answer with R.

edits.before: Q-farm at max range — your level 1 is honest at best. Bank Tear stacks and give nothing away.
edits.after: His Timewinder return hit chunks you every last-hit — Q-farm at max range, give nothing away.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online, but his Q slow into an auto still out-damages early Overload — answer engages, don't start trades.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: His W stun zone plus Phase Dive all-ins you inside root range — hold W for the dash, farm at max distance.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter hums, but his skirmish burst and roams pressure the map — short-trade and ping his exits.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Realm Warp online, but Chronobreak beats your all-in — shove to pin him mid and warp only when his R is spent.

notes: Suspect name 'Set Parallel Convergence' in wants.foe[1] is a false positive — Parallel Convergence is his real W. win[0-4] already read Ekko, so side edits go alone per the chart rule.
